description: Read one cluster's charter by THEME id: the pillar, objective and owner it sits under, its initiatives and their running/resourced/new split, the window, milestones, the measures it moves, funding source, stop condition, dependencies, and which charter lines are still owed. Edit the written lines through anyforge_update_theme — they live on the theme, so there is one writer.
name: anyforge_get_cluster_charter
title: Get cluster charter
